drafts.subject: EventPilot | Proposed charity event partnership — 2027-03-20
drafts.body:
Dear Printcious team,

We are preparing a proposed charity event for a student-selected charity (beneficiary unconfirmed) at Taylor's Lakeside Campus. Proposed date: 2027-03-20. Proposed venue: Lecture Theatres (approval and capacity unconfirmed). Our target is 100 attendees (planning assumption; not confirmed attendance). The proposed impact target is to direct net proceeds to the beneficiary after documented costs; the beneficiary, collection permission and amount raised are not yet confirmed.

Would you consider a hypothetical contribution of up to RM120.00 toward our unconfirmed funding gap, without assuming that your programme offers cash? A researched, proposed in-kind discussion could be: 100 button badges or lanyards, or an approved merchandise-printing discount; quantities and acceptance to be negotiated. Published constraints to review: Complete proposal at least 30 days before event; Products or special sponsorship pricing subject to approval and terms; Shipping not included; Do not guarantee unapproved social-media deliverables. Alternative proposed tiers are Supporting: RM150.00, Partner: RM300.00, Lead supporter: RM600.00. These are alternatives, not combined commitments. Any acknowledgement, logo use or student reach requires approval; no reach, tax benefit or exclusivity is guaranteed.

Please reply by 2027-02-13 if the proposal is relevant, or direct us to the appropriate partnerships channel. We will share approved beneficiary details and final venue confirmation before seeking a commitment.

Event organising team
Draft created by EventPilot; not sent.
